front_sections.heading: ABSTRACT
paragraphs: This sample shows what the generator produces: a cover page, automatic contents and figure/table lists, numbered headings down to the fourth level, numbered captions, and an APA reference list.
Every measurement comes from the template's own styles, so the output matches the writing guide without any value being repeated here.

sections.heading: INTRODUCTION
content: A first-level heading always starts a new page, is set in capitals at 14 pt bold, and is followed by body text at 12 pt with 1.5 line spacing.
Paragraphs are not indented; the guide asks for 6 pt of space before and after each one instead, and no blank line between them.

sections.heading: SCOPE
content: Second-level headings are capitals at 12 pt bold, with 24 pt before and 12 pt after.

list: First item of an unnumbered list.

sections.heading: Figures and Tables
content: A figure is centred and its caption sits underneath it; a table caption sits above the table. Both are numbered by chapter.

figure.caption: Sample figure placed by the generator.

table.caption: Sample table with a header row.

sections.heading: Fourth Level Heading
content: Fourth- to sixth-level headings are title case, 12 pt, italic, with 6 pt before and after.
In-text citations follow APA: a single author (Demirel, 2004: 130), two authors (Gültekin and Satterfield, 1995: 391-394), and more than two (Babakuş et al., 1996: 33-46).

references: Demirel, Ö. (2004). Kuramdan Uygulamaya Eğitimde Program Geliştirme (7th ed.). Ankara: Pegem A Yayıncılık.

Babakuş, E., Cravens, D. W., Johnston, M. and Moncrief, W. C. (1996). Examining the role of organizational variables in the salesperson job satisfaction model. Journal of Personal Selling and Sales Management, 16(3), 33-46.
Gültekin, N. and Satterfield, M. (1995). Rate of return on investment. Journal of Finance, 50(2), 391-394.
